name: Nameplate
feature_notes: The owner page identifies known businesses before sign-in. Online owners choose an email before entering a password. An autofill change to the chosen email stops the attempt.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open the Legacy Plumbing owner link in a signed-out tab to check the company name and email-first sign-in.
